# AKESTECH — Akestech Infotech

> AKESTECH (Akestech Infotech) is an AI-first growth technology company in
> Lucknow, India, serving clients across India and worldwide. Positioning:
> "Build. Automate. Grow." 200+ brands scaled, ₹50Cr+ ad spend managed.
> Contact: contact@akestech.com, +91 72750 13628, WhatsApp +91 72750 13628.
